name: 33_coax_hull_cutoff
title: Cylindrical Hull cutoff of a smooth-bore (coaxial) magnetron diode (RZ)

rows.case: B = 0.95 B*: anode current / B = 0 current (conducting, > 0.3)
B = 1.05 B*: anode current / B = 0 current (insulated, < 0.02)

notes: Inner cathode r_c = 5 mm, anode r_a = 10 mm, V = 10 kV, axial B, SCL emission. Lovelace-Ott: d_e = (r_a^2 - r_c^2)/(2 r_a) = 3.75 mm, B* = 90.36 mT (the planar formula with d = r_a - r_c would give 67.77 mT). Anode current / I(B=0) at B/B* = [0.8, 0.9, 0.95, 1.05, 1.1, 1.2]: [0.8611, 0.8043, 0.7552, -0.0, -0.0, -0.0].
